name: Reply patterns for verification support
description: Conservative wording for editable reply drafts. Every sentence is a template over extracted facts. This is a separate versioned artifact: the verification-support knowledge pack itself is unchanged.
reviewNotes: Every pattern here is new wording written for Phase 3C and has not been reviewed by the business: all are needs_review.

Patterns only restate what the customer said (as a claim), restate ticket status supplied by Node, or ask the customer a question. There is no pattern that promises, confirms receipt, confirms an outcome, quotes a time, or states policy.
Not implemented on purpose: 'the case is being checked'. It would need a verified Node fact that says work is in progress (an event or status), and that knowledge does not exist yet.

patterns.note: Courtesy opening; states nothing about the case.

patterns.template: You mentioned that you {action} your {entity}{count} and that it was {outcome}.
patterns.note: Restates a customer claim, hedged with 'You mentioned'.
Restates a customer claim; never says the action was received or completed on our side.

patterns.template: You mentioned that your {entity} was not {outcome}.
You mentioned that you have not {action} your {entity}.

patterns.note: Restates the customer's request when a document or verification was named.

patterns.template: Our records show this ticket as {value}.
patterns.note: States the ticket status Node supplied. Only used for status requests.

patterns.template: Could you let us know which document this relates to?
patterns.note: Used when the customer only said 'document' or similar.

patterns.template: Could you let us know which document or verification you are asking about?
patterns.note: Clarifying question when nothing specific was named.

patterns.template: Please reply to this message with any other details that may be relevant.
